title: 反射帯付き交通コーン
description: 中空のテーパー形状、反射帯、重量のあるゴム基部を備える交通コーン。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A hollow tapered traffic cone with reflective bands, rounded mouth and weighted rubber base. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
